name: graph_encode_score_midpoint_rounding
description: Symbol score is formatted to two decimals with round-half-to-even (banker's rounding) applied to the exact IEEE-754 double, matching the gcf-go reference (strconv/printf family). Scores 0.625 and 0.125 are exact binary midpoints for two-decimal rounding; round-half-to-even yields 0.62 and 0.12 (round toward the even last digit), NOT the 0.63 / 0.13 that a round-half-up formatter (e.g. JS Number.toFixed, Java String.format %f) would produce. Non-midpoint scores are unaffected because every implementation rounds the same exact double the same direction; only exact ties differ.
